device.description: Single 10-bit 65 MSPS low-latency low-power ADC with parallel DDR/SDR or serial CMOS outputs and SPI configuration
device.note: adc3910d125.pdf (SBASAD1A) p.3-4 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.8 digital inputs/outputs, p.12-13 timing (CMOS interface, SPI tOZD/tOD/tODZ), p.14-15 output timing diagrams (Figures 5-1/5-2: 10-bit data on D11..D2), p.48 digital interface (two's complement default), p.50-51 programming (Table 6-4 defaults, SPI write/read Figures 6-33/6-34), p.52-113 register map

registers.name: RESET
registers.note: p.54; RESET (bit 7, W) resets every register to its default and self-clears (the RESET command)

registers.name: CFG_ALERT
registers.note: p.54; CFG_ALERT reads 1 once the device is ready to be configured (2000 clock cycles after reset release); the table gives Reset = 0h (the value while not ready). The model is ready at once, so it starts at 1 so that a host polling it proceeds

registers.name: DEV_CFG_3
registers.note: p.57; FORMAT (bit 6) selects offset binary output in low latency mode (stored only)

registers.name: TEST_PAT_CFG
registers.note: p.59; the datasheet lists two registers at this address (TEST_PAT_CFG, TEST_PATTERN_CFG): merged

registers.name: COMP_HYSTERISIS_CHB_11_8
registers.note: p.70; the datasheet lists two registers at this address (COMP_HYSTERISIS_CHB_11:8, COMP_SLEW): merged

registers.name: BUF_CURR
registers.note: p.76; FORMAT_DIG (bit 6) selects offset binary output on the digital path (stored only)

commands.name: RESET
commands.note: write to register 0x00 with RESET (bit 7) = 1, p.54

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: R/W = 0, A[14:0], D[7:0] latched on SCLK rising edges (Figure 6-33, p.50)

commands.name: READ
commands.note: R/W = 1, A[14:0]; the register's D7..D0 follow on SDIO, driven on SCLK falling edges (Figure 6-34, p.51)

pages: p.3-4 (pins), p.5 (ROC: AVDD 1.7-1.9 V, IOVDD 1.7-1.9 or 3.2-3.4 V), p.8 (digital inputs referred to AVDD), p.12-13 (timing; SPI tOD 10.8 ns, tODZ 14 ns max; latency 1 clock), p.14-15 (Figures 5-1/5-2: DDR/SDR 10-bit on D11..D2), p.48 (two's complement default), p.49 (power down), p.50-51 (Table 6-4, 24-bit SPI words: R/W, A[14:0], D[7:0]), p.52-113 (register map; per-register page in each register note)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal/external reference, VCM output (the result is always the 0 V code 0x000, two's complement)
pipeline latency (1 clock cycle in low latency mode, 5 with the digital features) is not modeled (the code is constant); data change tPD (TS/4 + 3 ns) after the sampling clock falling edge
DCLK is modeled as the inverted sampling clock (it rises tPD after the CLK falling edge); DCLK/FCLK (the inverse data clock by default, or the frame clock with FCLK_EN) is not driven

only the default output interface is modeled: single-channel devices use SDR in low latency mode (p.13 note 1), the 10-bit word per sampling-clock falling edge on D11..D2 (Table 6-4: DDR, 10 lanes).  HDDR, SDR/DDR selection, serial CMOS (SERIALIZATION), DCLK divider, output data width (12/16-bit), output bit mapper (0xAE-0xB3), D1/D0 lanes, pin strengths and DCLK delays are stored only

DDC/decimation, digital comparators and hysteresis, statistics engine (0xE4-0x1A4 read 0), alerts (0x1AF-0x1ED), channel corrections (gain/offset), interleaving, test patterns (0x91-0x95, 0xA1-0xA6) and offset-binary output (FORMAT, FORMAT_DIG) do not change the output code
the ALERT pin (digital window comparator / over-range alert) is not driven

power-down: global/fast/channel power-down bits are stored only; the OEN/PD pin is modeled as the active-low output enable (its default); used as a power-down pin (OENZ_PDN, active high) it is not modeled
R/W = 1 disables further register writes until the next write cycle (read-back mode); words beyond a multiple of 24 bits are ignored
SPI is 3-wire: SDIO carries both directions (configBus mosi and miso are the same pin)
CFG_ALERT (0x38) reads 1 at once (the datasheet: ready 2000 clock cycles after reset release, reset value 0h)
the datasheet lists two registers at 0x91 (TEST_PAT_CFG, TEST_PATTERN_CFG) and at 0xD3 (COMP_HYSTERISIS_CHB_11:8, COMP_SLEW): each pair is merged into one register
register names containing ":" (e.g. TEST_PATTERN_CHB_7:0) are written with "_"; statistics/alert registers with hex names (0x0E4) are named R0E4; field names are the table's, wrapped lines joined

digital inputs RESET, OEN/PD, SCLK, SEN, SDIO are referred to AVDD (VIH 1.4 V, absolute maximum 2.1 V) and SDIO output to AVDD; vcc is the IOVDD range of the CMOS data outputs (1.7-1.9 V or 3.2-3.4 V): with IOVDD = 3.3 V the control inputs must still stay at or below 1.9 V, which the vcc range cannot say
the pin table lists NC as pin 17 (VREF's number); the pinout drawing shows NC on pin 5, used here
timing: tOut is the SPI SDIO output delay tOD 10.8 ns max and tFloat tODZ 14 ns max (the clocked data bus uses the same tOut)
sampling rate limits (65 MSPS max), SPI SCLK 20 MHz max, wake-up time
single-channel device: pins 14/15 (INBP/NC, INBM/NC) are no-connects; channel B registers exist in the map but have no effect
variants: ADC3910D025/D065/D125 (dual) and ADC3910S025/S065/S125 (single) share adc3910d125.pdf and one register map; they differ in maximum sampling rate (25/65/125 MSPS) and channel count. ADC3908 (8-bit) is a pin-compatible sibling with its own datasheet
